verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents a programmatic API reached through service accounts. It also offers dashboards-as-code, and its agent skills and MCP server cover dashboards, alerts, saved views and querying, so much of the UI surface is reachable without the UI. However, nothing in the evidence claims or shows full UI/API parity, and no public OpenAPI spec was found (probes returned 404). Missing for 10: a documented claim or demonstration of full UI-to-API parity, a published OpenAPI/API reference covering all resources, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Service accounts provide a secure way to grant programmatic API access to SigNoz without tying credentials to individual users.
any non-human system that needs to interact with the SigNoz API
create and modify dashboards, manage alerts and saved Explorer views
